identity.name: AgriPharma POS
identity.description: A clean, trustworthy, and efficient interface merging the precision of a pharmacy with the organic growth of agriculture. Professional, grounded, and high-contrast.

typography.installation: Add these fonts via Google Fonts in index.html or import in CSS: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@300..800&family=Public+Sans:wght@300..700&display=swap

primary.description: Deep Forest Green - Represents Trust and Nature. Use for Main Nav, Primary Buttons, Active States.

secondary.description: Sprout Green - Vibrant accent for Success, Highlights, and Callouts. Use sparingly.

accent.description: Pale Mint - Background for active items, subtle highlights.

pos_system.structure: Split Screen (66% Product Grid / 33% Cart Panel)
pos_system.cart_panel: fixed right-0 top-0 h-screen w-1/3 bg-white border-l shadow-xl z-20 flex flex-col

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-md transition-all active:scale-95 rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-input text-primary hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground shadow-sm transition-all rounded-lg

cards.product: flex flex-col h-full overflow-hidden group cursor-pointer border hover:border-primary transition-colors bg-white rounded-lg

inputs.base: flex h-11 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

login_background.description: Use as a split-screen background on the Login page.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. UPDATE THEME: Replace the CSS variables in /app/frontend/src/index.css with the values provided in 'colors.css_variables'. This is CRITICAL for the brand look.
2. FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import link to the public/index.html or CSS file.
3. ICONS: Use 'lucide-react' for all icons. Use 'Pill', 'Sprout', 'Stethoscope', 'Tractor', 'Leaf' icons where appropriate.
4. COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn/UI components (Button, Input, Card, Table) but customized with the 'rounded-lg' and 'rounded-xl' classes as per the radius variable.
5. CHARTS: Use 'recharts' for the Admin Dashboard. Map the colors to the 'chart_colors' palette.
6. POS LAYOUT: The POS page MUST be designed for speed. Use a persistent 'Cart Sidebar' on the right. The left side is a searchable Product Grid.
7. DATA-TESTID: Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, and key containers (e.g., 'login-submit', 'add-to-cart-btn').
8. NOTIFICATIONS: Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (e.g., 'Added to cart', 'Stock low').
9. FILE EXTENSIONS: Use .js/.jsx for all files.
10. RESPONSIVENESS: Ensure the POS layout collapses gracefully on tablet (1024px) but maintains the split view if possible, or uses a drawer for the cart on smaller screens.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics (generic gradients, centered layouts).
Create depth with layered shadows and subtle borders.
Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Animate specific properties (transform, opacity, colors).
Do NOT center-align the main app container. Use full-width layouts.
Interactive elements must have clear :hover and :active states.
Use 2-3x more padding than standard for a premium feel (e.g., p-6 or p-8 inside cards).
